name: Scandinavian Defense
blurb: Black hits e4 on the very first move with ...d5 and recaptures with the queen. Easy to learn, with a clear setup Black can reach against almost anything.

ideas.e4 d5: Attacks e4 on move one, so White has to decide about the centre straight away.
ideas.e4 d5 exd5 Qxd5: Takes back at once. The queen comes out early, but White needs a move to attack it.
ideas.e4 d5 exd5 Qxd5 Nc3 Qa5: The queen steps away from the knight. On a5 it is hard to attack and keeps an eye on the c3 knight.
ideas.e4 d5 exd5 Qxd5 Nc3 Qa5 d4 Nf6: Develops the knight and covers e4 and d5.
ideas.e4 d5 exd5 Qxd5 Nc3 Qa5 d4 Nf6 Nf3 Bf5: The bishop develops outside the pawn chain before ...e6 shuts it in.
ideas.e4 d5 exd5 Qxd5 Nc3 Qa5 d4 Nf6 Nf3 Bf5 N: Gives the queen a retreat square on c7 and covers b5 and d5.
ideas.e4 d5 exd5 Qxd5 Nc3 Qa5 Nf3 Nf6 d4 Bf5 B: Blocks the c4 bishop's line toward f7 and opens the way for the f8 bishop.
ideas.e4 d5 exd5 Qxd5 d4 Nc6: Against an early d4, the knight develops with an attack on the d4 pawn.
ideas.e4 d5 exd5 Qxd5 Nf3 Bg4: Pins the f3 knight to the queen.
ideas.e4 d5 e5 c5: Against e5, Black grabs space on the queenside and gets ready to pressure d4.
ideas.e4 d5 Nc3 d4: Kicks the knight away from c3 and gains space in the centre.
